title: Annotatio VI §.VIII: no dissent on substantial presence offered; true spiritual eating realer
pass_a_gloss: Because there is plainly no Dissensus about the true and substantial presence of Christ’s body and blood in the Sacred Supper, offered to all Communicants, and likewise about the true and real, yet spiritual and supernatural — and so much the truer and realer — Eating of Christ’s body and Drinking of the Blood.
pass_b_english: There is plainly no dissensus on true substantial presence of body and blood in the Supper, offered to all communicants.
Nor on true real eating and drinking that is spiritual and supernatural — and so much the truer and realer.
source_text: Quia Dissensus planè nullus est de vera & substantiali corporis & sanguinis Christi præsentia in Sacra Cœna, Communicantibus omnibus oblata, itemque de vera & reali, at spirituali & supernaturali, eóque tantò veriori & realiori corporis Christi Manducatione Sanguinísque Bibitione.
notes: Agreement on substantial + spiritual real eating.
